info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Interactions API enables users to retrieve comprehensive lists of interactions between various pharmacy prescriptions. This functionality is critical for healthcare providers, pharmacists, and developers integrating medication management systems, as it helps ensure patient safety by identifying potential drug interactions. By leveraging this API, users can optimize prescribing practices, enhance patient outcomes, and streamline the medication review process. Typical use cases include monitoring patient prescriptions and providing alerts for potential adverse interactions.

get.summary: Retrieve medication interaction details for prescriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch information about potential interactions between prescribed medications. It is essential for ensuring patient safety and optimizing prescription management.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve prescription interactions. It should contain the necessary details to query for drug interactions associated with a patient's prescriptions.
